title: Kirchhoff index of a nested geometric graph with weighted multiple edges
summary: Kirchhoff index, Kf(G), introduced by Klein and Randic in 1993, represents the total effective resistances between all pairs of vertices in a graph G, where each edge is regarded as a resistor. In this paper, the Kirchhoff indices of a particular sequence of nested geometric graphs with weighted multiple edges, denoted by Gn, are investigated. A recurrence relation for the characteristic polynomial of the Laplacian matrix L(Gn) is derived, and an explicit formula for Kf(Gn) is obtained.
